description: CLK2 (carrier about 145 MHz, 3rd harmonic wanted) with the Si5351 screened and a screened pad at the output, then an unidentified SAW filter, 30 cm of cable and the BNC attenuator marked 10 dB

chain.name: screened pad on the CLK2 output
chain.notes: fully screened pad, nominal 8 dB; measured 8.9 dB at 435 MHz (8.9 to 9.5 dB over 425 to 445 MHz) on 2026-11-03. Placed BEFORE the SAW, so it is not part of pad_db: levels in the results are those leaving the SAW, as in the older baselines, with this pad's loss included in them.

chain.name: SAW filter
chain.notes: wide passband, about 421-444 MHz at -3 dB (measured 2026-10-31); fitted directly after the pad, before the 30 cm cable

chain.name: 30 cm cable
chain.notes: SAW to the attenuator; the same cable as in the pad measurements; type not recorded

chain.name: attenuator
chain.notes: in front of the analyser; marked 10 dB, measured 25.8 dB at 435 MHz

notes: New topology (2026-11-03): screened Si5351 board, screened pad at the output, SAW straight after the pad. Compare with 70cm-screened-pad-nofilter-10dB (the same chain without the SAW) and with 70cm-tpad-12cm-pigtail-saw-unknown-10dB (T pad at the source). pad_db is 25.8 (cable and attenuator after the SAW), so levels are 'leaving the SAW' with the 8.9 dB source pad and the SAW's insertion loss included.
